events.detail_full_main: 倒木の影響で、喜多方〜津川駅間の運転を見合わせています。運転区間の一部列車に運休が出ています。
events.detail_full_zh: 受倒木影响，喜多方至津川站之间的列车已停运。部分区间的列车出现停运情况。
events.detail_full_en: Due to the impact of fallen trees, there is a suspension of services between Kitakata and Tsugawa stations. Some trains on the operating section are experiencing service suspension.

events.detail_full_main: 倒木の影響で、23日始発から、喜多方〜津川駅間の運転を見合わせます。
events.detail_full_zh: 受倒木影响，自23日首班车起，喜多方站至津川站区间将暂停运营。
events.detail_full_en: Due to the impact of fallen trees, services between Kitakata and Tsugawa stations will be suspended starting with the first trains on the 23rd.
